Perfect! Now I have all the information I need. Let me compile the comprehensive report.

## ABOUT PAGE EXPLORATION REPORT

### FILE PATHS

**PHP View File:**
- `/c/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/views/pages/about/index.php` (Main about page view)

**TypeScript Files:**
- `/c/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/resource/ts/pages/about/scene/about.scene.ts` (Scene configuration and DOM bindings)
- `/c/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/resource/ts/types/about.types.ts` (Type definitions)
- `/c/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/resource/ts/pages/about/theatre/AboutTheatreConfig.ts` (Theatre animation configuration)
- `/c/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/resource/ts/pages/about/theatre/AboutTheatreRuntime.ts` (Theatre animation runtime)
- `/c/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/resource/ts/pages/about/theatre/AboutSceneState.ts` (Scene state management)
- `/c/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/resource/ts/pages/about/theatre/AboutTheatreAutoplayRuntime.ts` (Autoplay logic)
- `/c/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/resource/ts/pages/about/theatre/AboutTheatreBridge.ts` (Theatre bridge)
- `/c/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/resource/ts/pages/about/theatre/AboutSceneRig.ts` (Scene rig setup)

**Data File:**
- `/c/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/resource/json/about.json` (Theatre animation keyframes and data)

---

### PAGE SECTIONS & CONTENT

The About page has **8 major sections** with their own Theatre animation sheets and scroll-triggered scenes:

#### 1. **Hero Intro** (`data-scene="heroIntro"`)
- **Headline:** "We Are" + "Explorers"
- **Tagline:** "Digital Web Agency"
- **Body Copy:** 
  ```
  우리는 방향이 없는 공간에서도 길을 만듭니다. 
  브랜드가 나아갈 좌표를 정의하고, 
  사용자가 자연스럽게 움직이는 흐름을 설계합니다. 
  그것이 나인원랩스입니다.
  ```
- **CTA:** "To Dive" button with arrow-down icon

#### 2. **Hero Slogan** (`data-scene="heroSlogan"`)
- **Dynamic Rotating Headline:**
  ```
  We Make Your (Design / Development / Branding / UI/UX) Journey
  ```
  - "Design", "Development", "Branding", "UI/UX" rotate dynamically with carousel animation
- **Animation Details:** Keywords rotate through a viewport with blur and text-shadow effects
- **Progress Range:** Reveal starts at 0.08, ends at 0.82 of scroll progress
- **Stagger:** 0.12 seconds between text item reveals

#### 3. **Who Section** (`data-scene="who"` - "We Elevate Your Brand")
- **Visual Title:** "We Elevate Your Brand" (displays in multi-layer composition with depth)
- **Visual Element:** Animated ring and 6 card carousel with brand images
- **Card Images:** References `/resource/images/main/main_why_img_1.jpg` through `main_why_img_6.jpg`
- **Animation:** Cards orbit, spawn, merge, and scatter on scroll
- **Surface Alpha:** Gradient alpha blending (0.24 to 0.72)

#### 4. **Mission & Vision** (`data-scene="missionVision"`)

**Vision Statement:**
```
Our Vision Is to Turn Bold Brands into Living Digital Journeys.

브랜드의 방향성과 감도를 선명하게 설계하고,
사용자의 흐름을 세심하게 연결합니다.
오래 기억되는 여정으로 브랜드의 다음 움직임을 함께 만들어갑니다.
```

**Mission Cards (3 items):**
1. **No Limit**
   - Index: 01
   - Description: "더 나은 경험을 위해, 언제나 새로운 시도를 이어갑니다."

2. **Prove Results**
   - Index: 02
   - Description: "디테일과 완성도를 끝까지 챙기며, 목표에 도달하는 결과로 증명합니다."

3. **Stand Out**
   - Index: 03
   - Description: "브랜드만의 개성과 차별점을 살려, 평범함을 넘어서는 웹 경험을 만듭니다."

#### 5. **Services** (`data-scene="services"`)
- **Section Title:** "Services"
- **Main Heading:** "Every Service Your Brand Needs, Handled By One **Team.** From Strategy To Execution."

**Service Items (5):**
1. **01 - Web Build**
   - "사람들이 느끼고 오래 기억하는 웹. 브랜드만의 독창적인 인터랙션으로 특별한 경험을 설계합니다."

2. **02 - App Build**
   - "브랜드는 화면 밖에서도 계속됩니다. 사용자가 편하게 쓰는 흐름을 중심으로, 손 안에서 완성되는 앱을 만듭니다."

3. **03 - Branding**
   - "브랜드를 한 문장으로 설명할 수 있어야 합니다. 핵심을 명확히 정리하고, 어디서나 같은 인상이 남는 정체성을 만듭니다."

4. **04 - UI · UX**
   - "목적에 맞는 구조와 동선으로, 사용자가 편하고 자연스럽게 다음 행동으로 이어지게 설계합니다."

5. **05 - Maintenance**
   - "서비스는 안정적으로 운영될 때 빛납니다. 구조를 정리하고, 문제가 생기기 전에 먼저 대응합니다."

#### 6. **Awards** (`data-scene="awards"`)
- **Section Title:** "Awards"
- **Dynamic Content:** Populated from database with columns:
  - Year
  - Project Title
  - Award Label (with optional icon)
  - Prize
- **Empty State:** "등록된 수상 작업이 없습니다." (No awards registered)
- **CTA:** "View More" button with plus icon linking to `/works?view=grid`
- **Interaction:** Hover preview images on award items

#### 7. **Partners/Clients** (`data-scene="client"`)
- **Section Title:** "Partners"
- **Content:** 22 client logo images
- **Logo Path Pattern:** `/resource/images/logo/client_logo_1.svg` through `client_logo_22.svg`
- **Note:** Logos are SVG files (no responsive picture element wrapping per frontend rules)

#### 8. **Contact CTA** (`data-scene="contact"`)
- **Main Headline:**
  ```
  Your Journey 
  Starts Here.
  ```
- **Body Copy:**
  ```
  브랜드의 첫 발사를 함께할 준비가 됐습니다.
  지금 나인원랩스와 여정을 시작하세요.
  ```
- **CTAs:**
  - "Contact" button (arrow icon after) → `/contact`
  - "Works" button (arrow icon after) → `/works`

---

### TYPESCRIPT ANIMATION & SCENE BINDINGS

#### Scene Section Keys (Theatre Sheet IDs)
```typescript
"heroIntro" | "heroSlogan" | "who" | "missionVision" | "services" | "awards" | "client" | "contact"
```

#### Scroll Scene Selectors (DOM targets)
```typescript
{
  heroIntro: '.no-sub-about-hero-intro[data-scene="heroIntro"]',
  heroSlogan: '.no-sub-about-hero-slogan[data-scene="heroSlogan"]',
  who: '.no-sub-about-who[data-scene="who"]',
  missionVision: '.no-sub-about-mission-vision[data-scene="missionVision"]',
  services: '.no-sub-about-services[data-scene="services"]',
  awards: '.no-sub-about-awards[data-scene="awards"]',
  client: '.no-sub-about-client[data-scene="client"]',
  contact: '.no-main-contact[data-scene="contact"]',
}
```

#### Scroll Progress Tracking
Each section uses scroll-based progress (0 to 1 normalized):

| Section | Scroll Span | Progress Lag | Progress Range | Power |
|---------|------------|-------------|----------------|-------|
| heroIntro | 220vh | 260ms | 0.04–0.96 | 1.02 |
| heroSlogan | 340vh | 300ms | 0.04–0.96 | 1.06 |
| who | 460vh | 300ms | 0.04–0.96 | 1.08 |
| missionVision | 160vh | 320ms | 0.03–0.94 | 1.1 |
| services | 180vh | 340ms | 0.03–0.93 | 1.1 |
| awards | 110vh | 300ms | 0.04–0.96 | 1.06 |
| client | 280vh | 320ms | 0.03–0.94 | 1.08 |
| contact | 320vh | 340ms | 0.08–0.96 | 1.08 |

#### DOM Animation Callbacks

**heroSlogan:**
- `onProgress()`: Syncs hero slogan visibility and text reveal stagger
- `onDispose()`: Cleans up text reveals and resets alpha (0.24)
- **Keyword Animation:** Uses `TextReveal.setVisibleOn/Off()` with 0.12s stagger between items

**missionVision:**
- `onProgress()`: Syncs journey surface alpha (segment 1 of 3)
- Surface alpha: 0.24 to 0.40

**services:**
- `onProgress()`: Syncs journey surface alpha (segment 2 of 3)
- Surface alpha: 0.40 to 0.56

**awards:**
- `onProgress()`: Syncs journey surface alpha (segment 3 of 3)
- Surface alpha: 0.56 to 0.72

**contact:**
- `onProgress()`: Reveals contact section head with text stagger reveal
- **Reveal Start:** 0.08 (of overall contact scroll progress)
- **Stagger:** `CONTACT_HEAD_TRANSITION.revealStagger` (defined in transition.config.ts)
- DOM state: `data-active="true/false"` on `.no-main-contact[data-scene="contact"]`, head, and actions elements
- Text targets: `.mask-target` elements inside contact head

#### Background/Visual States
Background variants controlled per scene:
- **heroIntro:** `aboutHeroIntro`
- **heroSlogan:** `aboutHeroSlogan`
- **who:** `aboutWhoIntro`
- **missionVision:** `aboutMissionVision`
- **services, awards, client, contact:** `aboutHeroSlogan` (shared)

#### Three.js Objects in Scene
- `aboutBackground` (background shader)
- `astronaut` (3D model)
- `earth` (3D model)
- `rocket` (3D model with flame effect)
- `jetEngine` (attached to rocket)
- `aboutLights` (lighting rig)
- `terrian` (terrain/ground)

#### Theatre Autoplay
- **Intro Sheet:** `heroIntro` at 1.8x playback rate
- **After Intro:** Disabled (would be `heroSlogan` at 0.84x if enabled)
- **Playback File:** `/resource/json/about.json` contains all keyframe data for camera, lights, objects

### CSS CUSTOM PROPERTIES (Animation Variables)

- `--hero-slogan-surface-alpha` (0.24–0.72, controls visibility)
- `--about-journey-surface-alpha` (0.24–0.72, three-segment progression)
- `--loop-filter-delay-base` (staggered animation delay for service items)

### KEY INTERACTIONS & ACCESSIBILITY

- Canvas container: `aria-hidden="true"`
- Hero Intro: Visible on load (aria-hidden=false), receives focus
- Other sections: aria-hidden="true" initially, managed by scroll controller
- Text reveals use `.mask-target` class for animation hooks
- Block reveals use `BlockReveal` utility for section show/hide
- "To Dive" scroll button in hero section invokes scroll behavior
